_comment: Source of truth for Cy data handling. Update this whenever collection, storage, transmission, retention, or deletion changes. Policy wording requires human approval before release.
collects: Postcard text, an optional chosen handle, and an optional uploaded or Openverse-selected image voluntarily submitted by a visitor
A random visitor identifier in a signed HttpOnly cookie, used to recognise a returning postcard writer
IP addresses on postcard and rate-limit records for abuse prevention
Short-lived viewer-presence observations derived from event-stream polling
Owner-selected runner controls including tempo, day or night regime, pause state, and model provider
stores: The ordered public event stream, including screened Cy prose, prison events, public postcard fields, drawings, operational telemetry, Soma snapshots containing current experienced-state values and their causal contributors, generation-inspection payloads that separately retain grounded Soma prompt facts, an optional traceable provisional retrieval candidate, recent expression, fixed character fiction, and engineering world mechanics, and autonomous expressive-choice inspection records containing the supplied bounded context, allowed actions, parsed choice and engineering-fallback status
Private structured prison-world records separating objective event facts, Cy's observation, normalized categorical Soma input, and named consuming systems for the admin-only event inspector
Queued and delivered postcards, their reply-tray or fan-mail class, delivery, promotion and reply timestamps, submitted text, optional handle, moderation state, and rate-limit metadata
Uploaded or remotely selected postcard images re-encoded as WebP with metadata removed, plus source attribution when applicable
A returning visitor's postcard count, compact rolling notes, and legacy synthetic standing values

On the Dell runner, a bounded Soma episodic memory of up to 512 selected environmental events. An episode may contain postcard text or caption, a prison incident, a warden notice, or machine-continuity evidence, together with time, category, tags, and computed salience

On the Dell runner, learned event-family expectations, up to 128 bounded word associations learned from lived input, current attention and action, self-output action feedback, self-model evidence, eight experienced-state values with their causal contributor ledgers, and up to seven days of downsampled experienced-state history in the gitignored runtime state file

On the Dell runner, normalized homeostatic sleep pressure (Process S), its explicit uncertainty interval, current observed sleep state, model and provenance identifiers, last integration details, and up to seven days of post-installation Process S history

On the Dell runner, the complete post-installation structured feeding ledger: meal expectation, offering, availability, receipt, consumption outcome, exact observed or categorical portion information, explicit nutrition when supplied, HMPPS reference-ration energy when nutrition is absent, source event identifiers, last known intake, missed scheduled meals, and explicit runner-observation gaps

On the Dell runner, physiological-satiety-v1 state containing 225 deterministic GI-model tracks over bounded meal-composition and published parameter uncertainty, including stomach and intestinal fat/carbohydrate compartments, CCK, GLP-1, PYY, ghrelin, pending ingestion, clean-anchor and continuity status, latest calculation trace, and no pre-installation history

On the Dell runner, published circadian Process C metadata and evaluations, including the configured habitual wake basis, schedule-estimated CBTmin interval, mathematically derived circular phase interval, explicit phase uncertainty, model and provenance identifiers, and up to seven days of post-installation evaluation history

On the Dell runner, independent Beta-Bernoulli posteriors for structured cue and categorical adverse-outcome pairs, plus the complete post-installation sequence of resolved updates with exact before and after parameters, outcome status, information-theoretic surprisal, timestamp, and source environment event identifiers

On the Dell runner, current defensive-context records and their complete post-installation transition history, including present structured cue IDs, attached learned posterior snapshots, categorical world ambiguity and temporal status, objective controllability, outcome and resolution status, timestamps, and source environment event identifiers

On the Dell runner, the complete post-installation structured action-opportunity ledger and context-by-action-by-outcome Beta-Bernoulli evidence, including actual action availability, deliberate selection or non-selection, execution status, timestamps, resolved outcomes, exact before/after posteriors and source environment event identifiers

On the Dell runner, pending prison instrumental opportunities, their deterministic engineering selection cursors, the selected action, actor, opening event identity, and the identifiers needed to derive the factual branch awaiting resolution so an open opportunity survives a restart

On the Dell runner, the complete post-installation structured somatic event history and persistent injury ledger, including stimulus identity and modality, categorical noxious status, onset and offset, body site and laterality, tissue-damage and injury status, stable injury identity, explicit resolution, observation certainty, source event identifiers and field provenance
On the Dell runner, a rolling context of screened Cy-generated prose, operational logs, electricity and paid-provider spend totals, and retry queues

In the visitor's browser, only the numeric IDs, submission times, and waiting/responding state of that browser's postcards awaiting a reply, retained for at most 24 hours so waiting state survives a refresh

transmits.purpose: Deliver one selected reply item to Cy, screen and archive fan mail without prompting the model, and maintain the continuous process
transmits.data: Selected reply postcard text and image reference, chosen handle, returning-visitor memory and standing; fan-mail postcard content for screening and public archiving; warden notices, news, tempo, and owner controls

transmits.purpose: Publish the screened experience and maintain queued visitor interactions
transmits.data: Batched public events and private visitor, drawing, structured prison-world, exact feeding-ledger traces, exact somatic-event and injury-ledger traces, exact probabilistic threat-learning traces, exact current defensive-context transitions, exact action-opportunity/action-outcome update traces, and prison instrumental situation/action/consequence records from the Dell runner

transmits.recipient: DeepSeek, only while the owner has selected the optional remote provider
transmits.purpose: Generate Cy's prose or drawing instructions, and select an autonomous outward expressive form
transmits.data: The current prose or drawing prompt can include recent screened Cy prose, a compact epistemically labelled projection of LIVE grounded sleep, physiological-satiety range, defensive-context, learned cue-outcome, matching action-outcome, feeding, somatic and social-contact state, an optional heuristic retrieval of exact material from a traceable structured environment event, recent incidents, incoming postcard text, and factual returning-visitor identity/count/timing. Physiological Satiety is labelled as a model estimate rather than subjective Hunger. Numeric heuristic attention, prediction error, word associations, relationship standing, monotony amplification and provisional visitor-facing metrics are not sent as psychological state. Before an autonomous expressive episode, a separate small structured chooser sends the current grounded projection, bounded current/recent incident context, the optional traceable event candidate, and the currently available journal/draw/silence IDs.

transmits.recipient: Openverse and the host of a selected public image
transmits.purpose: Search for a visitor-requested postcard image and fetch the selected public image
transmits.data: The visitor's image-search query is sent to Openverse; the selected image URL is then requested from its host

transmits.purpose: Render and replay the live or historical Cy experience
transmits.data: Screened public event-stream content, public reply postcards and fan-mail fields, drawings, operational telemetry, Soma values labelled from the implementation registry as LIVE, PROVISIONAL, or NOT MODELLED, the modelled physiological-satiety range and bounded GI/hormone ranges without private source identifiers, qualitative cue-outcome associations from the probabilistic threat learner, categorical public summaries of active current defensive contexts without source event identifiers, exact aggregate action/no-action posteriors and observational contingency differences without opportunity or source event identifiers, recent structured feeding outcomes with last known intake and explicit continuity status, recent structured somatic and injury facts without source event identifiers, and chronological prison instrumental situations, Cy actions, and factual consequences

does_not_store: Raw uploaded image metadata after re-encoding
Model-provider API keys in the repository or public event stream
Blocked postcard text or blocked model output in the public event stream
A biological or clinical measurement of Cy; brain locations and legacy vitals are explicit analogies or planned synthetic values
notes: Process S consumes categorical sleep onset, waking, interruption, return-to-sleep and forced-wakefulness records. It is a sleep-homeostasis construct, not a biological measurement or validated subjective-fatigue score, and no old fatigue values are used to backfill it.

Process C is a deterministic published circadian waveform evaluated from clock time. Its biological phase is not observed; a phase interval is estimated from the configured habitual wake schedule, and public history curves are mathematically reconstructed from that stored basis rather than presented as biological measurements.

Process S and Process C remain separate. No equation combines them into the provisional fatigue value. Their estimates may enter the grounded prompt projection with explicit epistemic labels, but they do not create a subjective Fatigue claim, mood value, action selection, or other visitor-facing Soma variable.

Structured feeding records remain separate from the legacy provisional Hunger value. Resolved intake supplies explicit nutrition or documented HMPPS reference-ration energy to physiological-satiety-v1, which models GI compartments, CCK, GLP-1, PYY, ghrelin and a bounded physiological-satiety score. It does not model subjective Hunger, metabolic energy balance, appetite, brain activation, or action selection.

Physiological-satiety-v1 initializes only at a clean observed breakfast anchor. Unknown portion or intake and newly observed runner gaps preserve input uncertainty; old Hunger values and histories never initialize, update or backfill it.
The complete feeding ledger and its source event identifiers are available only through the owner-gated inspector. The public view receives the bounded recent summary carried by the Soma snapshot.

Probabilistic threat learning uses an uninformative Beta(1,1) prior and exact Bernoulli updates only for explicit, self-contained, resolved structured trials. Unknown outcomes do not update. Exact posteriors and update history are owner-only; public viewers receive qualitative association summaries.

The threat learner does not read generated prose, sentiment, legacy appraisal magnitudes, relationship scores, or existing anxiety values. Exact learned evidence may enter the grounded prompt projection only when a current defensive context has a matching active cue; it does not create anxiety, arousal, action selection, or brain-region activation.
Legacy warm or hostile postcard word matching is not admissible threat-learning evidence and does not update the grounded learner.

Current defensive context is event-driven and uses only present external cues in structured world records. It stores separate learned cue-outcome posteriors, matching observational action-outcome evidence, ambiguity, categorical imminence, objective control and resolution; it does not calculate anxiety, fear, salience, perceived control, causal control or brain activation.

Exact defensive-context posteriors, source events and transition history are owner-only. Public viewers receive categorical context facts and qualitative evidence balance without private event IDs or exact posterior parameters.

Action-outcome learning uses separate Beta(1,1) Bernoulli posteriors for an explicitly available action being executed and deliberately not executed within the same structured context and adverse-outcome class. Unknown, unavailable, prevented, merely attempted and unresolved records do not update.

The public action-outcome view exposes exact aggregate counts, posterior parameters, means, variances and their difference, but not opportunity or source event identifiers. The complete opportunity ledger and update trace are owner-only.

Action-outcome differences are observational and may be confounded. Matching-context evidence may enter the grounded prompt projection with that limitation preserved, but it does not establish causal control, perceived control or helplessness and does not alter Anxiety, other affect, action selection or brain-region activation.

Prison instrumental opportunities extend five audited existing officer and inmate incident types. They use explicit two-branch world consequences and no new probability, affect magnitude, relationship scalar, control weight or model-generated prose.

Live instrumental action selection is a persisted deterministic round-robin engineering mechanism so both available branches can occur. It is explicitly not a psychological, grounded, learned or Soma-driven model of Cy's choice.

Instrumental opportunities resolve on the next existing world scheduler tick. This introduces no separate psychological timing constant; unresolved opportunities and their selected action remain pending across runner restarts.

Structured somatic records remain separate from the provisional Pain / Discomfort value. Active stimulus and injury facts may enter the grounded prompt projection, but they do not create subjective Pain, general discomfort, healing, sensitisation, allodynia, hyperalgesia, nocifensive action or brain activation.

The grounded Soma prompt projection is an engineering selection of already stored LIVE subsystem facts and model estimates. It adds no emotion mapping, threshold, weight, probability or new grounded state, and records categorical omissions for inspection.

Grounded Soma prompt facts may influence Cy's generated subjective prose. Generated prose remains isolated from grounded sleep, threat-learning, defensive-context, feeding, action-outcome, somatic and social-contact state and cannot become evidence for those systems.

Heuristic attention, prediction mismatch and learned word associations remain diagnostics only. Heuristic episodic retrieval may supply at most one optional item labelled PROVISIONAL RETRIEVAL CANDIDATE, but only when it contains the exact stored text, timestamp, kind and source identifier of a structured environment event. Generated prose and heuristic summaries cannot become factual memory material.

Autonomous journal, draw or silence choice is model-mediated subjective character behaviour, not grounded or scientific psychological action selection. Only the parsed action, allowed focus references and fixed descriptive reason category are stored; hidden chain-of-thought is neither requested nor stored.

The old heuristic drive selector remains disabled legacy code. A selected expressive action and resulting prose or drawing are not written back as evidence for grounded Soma or as a measured psychological state.

A stimulus ending does not resolve its injury, elapsed time does not imply healing, and only an explicit structured resolution naming an existing injury closes it. Unknown somatic facts remain unknown rather than becoming no harm.
Complete somatic event, injury and source-event traces are owner-only. The public view receives a bounded recent factual summary without private environment-event identifiers.

Screened model text returns to Soma only as a bounded efference copy of Cy's action: repetition, intensity, commitments, and activation of word associations previously learned from lived input. Text sentiment cannot directly manufacture appraisal or emotional state.

Fan mail is retained and made publicly replayable after runner-side screening, but it is not treated as something Cy perceived and does not affect Soma unless it is later promoted into the reply tray.
Soma memory is bounded by count and preferentially retains salient older episodes alongside recent ones; a time-based deletion period is not currently implemented.
Policy wording generated from this manifest requires human review before release.
